text: Stonehenge has a six-ton stone... that came from nowhere.
But wait. Didn't scientists solve this?
They thought so. Then it all fell apart.
It's called the Altar Stone. Long as a pickup truck. Lying right in the middle.
In 2024, a study traced it to northeast Scotland. Four hundred sixty miles away.
So ancient people dragged six tons... across half of Britain?
But then a new team grabbed seventy rocks from that exact spot.
So the most famous rock in Britain is homeless again.
Now the hunt moves to northern England, other parts of Scotland, even Ireland.
Whoever finds it finally learns how they moved it.
Until then, Stonehenge has a six-ton stone... that came from nowhere.
